text: 沪指早间红盘震荡，创业板指高开低走收跌0.17%，沪指涨0.27%，深成指跌0.06%。个股涨跌互现，上午半天成交9173亿。两市共2370只个股上涨，45只个股涨停。医药股集体走强，康希诺、泰诺麦博、美诺华、奥赛康等多股涨停。农业股盘中拉升，海南橡胶涨停。地产股探底持续回升，深物业A上演地天板，陆家嘴涨停。下跌方面，PCB概念股下挫，澳弘电子跌停。
text_en: The Shanghai Composite Index fluctuated in positive territory in the morning, while the ChiNext Index opened higher and moved lower to close down 0.17%; the Shanghai Composite rose 0.27% and the Shenzhen Component fell 0.06%. Stocks rose and fell mixed, with half-day turnover at 917.3 billion yuan. A total of 2,370 stocks in the two markets rose, with 45 hitting the daily limit. Pharmaceutical stocks strengthened collectively, with CanSino Biologics, Tainuo Maibo, Menovo Pharmaceutical, and Aosaikang and many others hitting the daily limit. Agricultural stocks rallied during the session, with Hainan Rubber hitting the daily limit. Real estate stocks kept rebounding after bottoming, with Shenwuye A staging a floor-to-ceiling move and Lujiazui hitting the daily limit. On the decline, PCB concept stocks dropped, with Aohong Electronics hitting the daily limit.
